mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand environment, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
